dialogue.origin: こんばんは。
dialogue.content: Good evening.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは、宜しくお願い致します、
dialogue.content: Good evening. Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: I look forward to speaking with you as well.

dialogue.origin: お時間少し早いですが始めさせて頂いてもよろしいでしょうか？それともジャストで始めた方がよいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: We're a little early; is it alright if we get started now? Or would you prefer we begin exactly on time?

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です
dialogue.content: That's fine.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございますでは、始めさせていただきます
dialogue.content: Thank you. Then let’s begin.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは、相談員ですよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Good evening. I'm your counselor. It's a pleasure to speak with you.

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.content: Thank you, likewise.

dialogue.origin: ニックネームで構いませんのでお呼びしてよいお名前お伺いできますでしょうか？
dialogue.content: A nickname is perfectly fine. Could you please tell me what I should call you?

dialogue.origin: (スミレ)すみれでお願い致します
dialogue.content: (Sumire) Please call me Sumire.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: スミレさん、今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Sumire, what brings you here today?

dialogue.origin: はい、親友がパチンコ依存性になってしまって困っています。
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm troubled because my best friend has become addicted to pachinko.

dialogue.origin: ご親友さまの事でご心配なのですね
dialogue.content: You're worried about your best friend, aren't you?

dialogue.origin: はい、パチンコも、儲かるときと負ける時が、あり、一か月にすると、半、半位なんです
dialogue.content: Yes. With pachinko, there are times they win and times they lose. Over a month, it's about half and half.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですねご親友さんはパチンコなさってどの位になられるのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. How long has your best friend been playing pachinko?

dialogue.origin: もう、10年位やっていて、パチプロ並です。負けが続くと、私の友人何人かの所にお金を借りに行ってしまうので。困っています。
dialogue.content: It's been about 10 years now, and they're almost at a professional level. When they're on a losing streak, they go to several of my friends to borrow money. It's become a problem.

dialogue.origin: 10年見守り続けてこられたのですねそれは長い期間大変でしたね
dialogue.content: So you've been watching over them for 10 years. That must have been very difficult for you for such a long time.

dialogue.origin: それに、
dialogue.content: And,

dialogue.origin: 他のご友人にお金を借りてもしまわれるのは本当にお困りですよね
dialogue.content: It must be truly troubling that they even borrow money from your other friends.

dialogue.origin: もう、直らないのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is it impossible for them to recover?

dialogue.origin: スミレさんにはお金をお借りには来られないのですか？
dialogue.content: Don't they come to borrow money from you, Sumire?

dialogue.origin: 私の所に来ましたが、断りました。
dialogue.content: They did come to me, but I refused.

dialogue.origin: お断りできたのですねそれはそれでお辛かったでしょうね
dialogue.content: You were able to say no—that must have been difficult in its own way.

dialogue.origin: はい、勇気を持って断りました。貸して終うと、また、パチンコに行ってしまい、同じ事の繰り返しになるので、
dialogue.content: Yes, I gathered the courage to refuse. If I lend them money, they'll just go back to pachinko, and it will be the same cycle repeating.

dialogue.origin: 貸してしまうとです
dialogue.content: I mean, if I end up lending them the money.

dialogue.origin: 本当に勇気のいる決断だったでしょね頑張られましたね
dialogue.content: That must have been a truly courageous decision. You did very well.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: では、スミレさんはお金の事よりご親友さんの依存が治るか治らないかをご心配なさっておられるのですね
dialogue.content: So, more than the money, you're worried about whether or not your best friend's addiction can be cured.

dialogue.origin: なおらなかったら、このさき、どうなってしまうか心配です。友達は、貸しても、かえって来ないだろうと、これっきりよと、3000円あげたそうです
dialogue.content: I'm worried about what will happen to them in the future if this isn't cured. One of our friends apparently gave them 3,000 yen, saying, 'This is the last time,' thinking they probably wouldn't get it back anyway.

dialogue.origin: そうですよねご心配になりますよねご親友であられる訳ですから
dialogue.content: I understand. Of course you'd be worried, since they are your best friend.

dialogue.origin: ご友人さん達も今では貸さない方向にむいているわけですね
dialogue.content: And your other friends are now leaning toward not lending, is that right?

dialogue.origin: 友人達も困って連絡がありますけど親友が借りに来たよと
dialogue.content: My friends are also troubled and contact me, saying that our friend came to borrow money.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたかご親友さんとはいつからのご関係なのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. How long have you known your best friend?

dialogue.origin: 幼なじみで、近所に住んでいます。
dialogue.content: We're childhood friends and live in the same neighborhood.

dialogue.origin: 近所の方の所へも、借りに行きましたので、ビックリしてしまいました
dialogue.content: They even went to neighbors to borrow money, which really shocked me.

dialogue.origin: 幼い頃からのお付き合いなのですねそれでは家族の様に気になってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: So you've known each other since you were little. It's natural that you'd worry about them as if they were family.

dialogue.origin: はい、そんなんです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's how it is.

dialogue.origin: ご近所の方にまでお借りにいかれてしまわれたのですか・・・そんなお話をお聞きになられたら驚かれるのも当然ですよね
dialogue.content: They even went to borrow money from your neighbors... It's completely understandable that you would be shocked to hear that.

dialogue.origin: パチンコをやっていることが、度を過ぎていても、平気なんです
dialogue.content: Even though their pachinko playing is excessive, they seem unfazed.

dialogue.origin: ご親友さんにしてみれば日課になられてしまっていらっしゃる感じですね
dialogue.content: It sounds like for your best friend, it has become a daily routine.

dialogue.origin: そんなんです
dialogue.content: That's how it is.

dialogue.origin: ご親友さんにはご家族はいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.content: Does your best friend have any family?

dialogue.origin: いません
dialogue.content: No.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですねだから余計にスミレさんはご心配をせざる負えない状態なのですね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be why you can't help but worry about them even more.

dialogue.origin: ずっと、独身でアパートを借りています。
dialogue.content: They’ve always been single and have been renting an apartment.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 借家住まいともなると生活の面も心配になってしまわれますよね
dialogue.content: Living in a rental, you must also be worried about their general livelihood.

dialogue.origin: そんなんですけど家賃も滞納していないか心配です。
dialogue.content: That’s right—I'm also worried they might be behind on their rent.

dialogue.origin: そうですよねご親友さんはお仕事はなさっておられないのですか？
dialogue.content: I understand. Is your best friend not working?

dialogue.origin: 仕事をしています。自分のお給料で、パチンコをやっているので、悪くないでしょう。とわたしの話しも聞き入れません
dialogue.content: They do have a job. They say, 'I'm playing pachinko with my own salary, so there's nothing wrong with it,' and won't listen to what I have to say.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたかお給料をつぎ込み、ご友人にもお金を借り、生活面でも家賃滞納などご心配がつきなく混乱してしまいますよね
dialogue.content: I see. Pouring their salary into it, borrowing money from friends, and the constant worry about things like unpaid rent must be very confusing and overwhelming for you.

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 依存の方はご自身が依存症だと気が付かない所も心配とどうして良いか悩みになってしまわれますね
dialogue.content: With addiction, it's also concerning that the person often doesn't realize they have a problem, which leaves you worried and unsure of what to do.

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: スミレさんの他には、同じように心配なさってくれる方はいらっしゃらないのですか？
dialogue.content: Besides you, Sumire, is there anyone else who is similarly concerned for them?

dialogue.origin: 幼なじみなので、私が一番長く関わっています。
dialogue.content: Since we're childhood friends, I've been the most involved for the longest time.

dialogue.origin: では10年間スミレさんお一人で寄り添われご心配の中悩んでこられたのですねさぞお辛かったでしょうね
dialogue.content: So for 10 years, you've been by their side, worrying and struggling with this on your own. That must have been so painful for you.

dialogue.origin: はい、回りの友達は、困った方位で、それ以上は考えない方がた
dialogue.content: Yes. My other friends are just troubled by it, but they don't think about it any further than that.

dialogue.origin: です
dialogue.content: That's how they are.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたかご親友さんがパチンコを始めたきっかけはなにかあったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. Was there any particular trigger that made your best friend start playing pachinko?

dialogue.origin: 何か、おもしろくないことがあると、気晴らしに仕事の帰り直行しています
dialogue.content: When something unpleasant happens, they go straight there after work to blow off steam.

dialogue.origin: 特にきっかけがあった訳ではないのですね？
dialogue.content: So there wasn’t a specific trigger?

dialogue.origin: はい、精神的なものだと思います
dialogue.content: No, I don't think so. I think it's something psychological.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか精神的なものとは？何かおありになられてたのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. Psychological? Did something happen to them?

dialogue.origin: 仕事などで、おもしろくないことがあると、家に帰る前にパチンコをしてから、気持ちを切り替えていえに帰るという、繰り返しです
dialogue.content: When something unpleasant happens at work or something, they play pachinko before going home to reset their mood, and then they go home. It's a cycle.

dialogue.origin: そうですか家族もおらず、面白くないことがあるとパチンコでしか気を紛らわす事が出来ない日々なのですね
dialogue.content: I see. So with no family, when unpleasant things happen, they spend their days unable to distract themselves with anything but pachinko.

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: 今までのお話をお伺いして感じたのですが、
dialogue.content: Based on what you've told me so far,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご親友さんは、家に帰っても家族もおられず、面白くない事があっても親身に話す相手もいず、パチンコでしか憂さ晴らしが出来ない環境になられておいでなようですが
dialogue.content: it seems your best friend is in a situation where they have no family to go home to, no one to confide in when something unpleasant happens, and the only way they can vent their frustrations is through pachinko.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 依存を治す。と言う団体に相談も行く気にはなりそうもない感じはします
dialogue.content: It sounds like they’re not likely to feel up to consulting with organizations that help people recover from addiction.

dialogue.origin: 本人は、依存性とは思っていないので、困ります
dialogue.content: They don't think they have an addiction, which is the problem.

dialogue.origin: パチンコでしか穴埋め出来ない事をお二人で何か新しいご趣味や、日ごろの愚痴などをゆっくり聞いてあげるお時間を作るなどはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Since pachinko is the only way they can fill that void, what would you think about the two of you trying a new hobby together or setting aside time to calmly listen to their daily frustrations?

dialogue.origin: スミレさんのお話をお聞きしている限りでは、
dialogue.content: From what I’m hearing from you,

dialogue.origin: そうですね、何か、気持ちが前向きになるよいなことを、考えてます。
dialogue.content: That's true. I'm thinking about something that could help them feel more positive.

dialogue.origin: 考えてみますです。
dialogue.content: I will give it some thought.

dialogue.origin: ご親友さんを見捨てる事は出来ない絆があるように思えるので、お二人の良き新たな時間づくりにチャレンジしてみても良いかと思いました
dialogue.content: It sounds like there's a bond that won’t let you abandon your best friend, so I thought it might be good to try creating some new, positive time together.

dialogue.origin: はい、努力してみます。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes, I'll do my best. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: お役に立てたかは分かりませんが、違う見方も必要な気がいたしました
dialogue.content: I'm not sure how helpful I was, but I felt that a different perspective might be needed.

dialogue.origin: はい、わかりました。ありがとうございました。合掌
dialogue.content: Yes, I understand. Thank you. (Praying hands)

dialogue.origin: 今日はお話くださりありがとうございましたまた、何かありましたらご相談にいらしてください
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing with me today. Please feel free to come and talk again if anything else comes up.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました。合掌
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much. (Praying hands)

dialogue.origin: では、今日はこれで終了となりますが大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Well then, we'll conclude our session for today. Is that alright?

dialogue.origin: はい、お世話さまになりました。合掌
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you for your help. (Praying hands)

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございましたご親友さんにとってもスミレさんにとってもお二人の新たな関係性を応援しております
dialogue.content: Thank you. I’m rooting for both your best friend and you as you build a new relationship together.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとうございましたでは、失礼いたします
dialogue.content: Thank you as well. Goodbye for now.

dialogue.origin: (時間オーバーになりましたがお付き合いくださりありがとうございました)
dialogue.content: (We went over time, but thank you for staying with me.)

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: (納得の行く終わり方が出来ず残念でしたがとっても勉強になりました。ありがとうございます。)
dialogue.content: (It's a shame we couldn't reach a more satisfactory conclusion, but it was a great learning experience. Thank you.)

dialogue.origin: (又、お会い出来たらよろしくお願いいたします。)
dialogue.content: (If we meet again, I look forward to speaking with you.)

dialogue.origin: はい、宜しくお願い致します。合掌
dialogue.content: Yes, I look forward to it. (Praying hands)

dialogue.origin: (では、終了ボタン押させていただきますね。)
dialogue.content: (Okay, I'll press the end button now.)

dialogue.origin: ではでは！
dialogue.content: Alright then!

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

topic.sub: 親友のパチンコ依存による関係の悪化
